#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
root=/tmp/tp-glm53-resident-full100
export PLOW_HSACO_LOWRUNG=""
export PLOW_DSTEP_LOG=0
if [ "$#" = 0 ]; then set -- on; fi
for arm in "$@"; do
    export PLOW_HSACO="$root/overlay"
    "$root/plowrt" serve --assets "$root/assets-$arm" --port 18999 > "$root/server-$arm.log" 2>&1 &
    server=$!
    trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
    ready=0
    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
        if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18999/v1/models > "$root/models-$arm.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
        kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
        sleep 1
    done
    [ "$ready" = 1 ]
    python3 runtime/bench/amd/mla_sparse_aiter/quality.py http://127.0.0.1:18999 "resident-$arm" "$root/quality-$arm.json" --concurrency 20 > "$root/quality-$arm.log" 2>&1
    env VLLM_ROCM_LIB=/opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib /app/plow/build-gemma31/vllm-python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve --backend vllm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18999 --model glm-5.3-plow-lite --tokenizer zai-org/GLM-5.3 --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random --num-prompts 100 --random-input-len 70000 --random-output-len 700 --random-range-ratio 0.14 --max-concurrency 20 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir "$root" --result-filename "serve-$arm.json" > "$root/bench-$arm.log" 2>&1
    kill -TERM "$server"
    wait "$server" || [ "$?" = 143 ]
    trap - EXIT
done

import collections
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct

REC = struct.Struct('<IIIHHQQQ')


def parse(data, expected):
    assert len(data) % REC.size == 0
    cutoff = max(r[7] for r in REC.iter_unpack(data) if r[2:4] == (0, 6) and r[7])
    groups = {}
    stale = empty = 0
    for cu, pc, inst, op, sl, ta, tr, te in REC.iter_unpack(data):
        if te == 0 and ta == 0:
            empty += 1
            continue
        if te < cutoff:
            stale += 1
            continue
        if inst == 0 and op == 6:
            continue
        assert inst in expected, ('unexpected current instruction', inst, op)
        e = expected[inst]
        assert op == e['op'], (inst, op, e['op'])
        assert 0 < ta <= tr <= te, (inst, ta, tr, te)
        assert cu < 304 and sl < e['blocks'], (inst, cu, sl, e['blocks'])
        g = groups.setdefault(inst, dict(op=e['op_name'], slices=set(), arrive=ta, ready=tr, end=te, body=0))
        assert sl not in g['slices'], ('duplicate slice', inst, sl)
        g['slices'].add(sl)
        g['arrive'] = min(g['arrive'], ta)
        g['ready'] = max(g['ready'], tr)
        g['end'] = max(g['end'], te)
        g['body'] += te - tr
    assert set(groups) == set(expected), ('missing instructions', set(expected) - set(groups))
    rows = []
    for inst, g in sorted(groups.items()):
        assert g['slices'] == set(range(expected[inst]['blocks'])), ('missing slices', inst, len(g['slices']))
        rows.append(dict(inst=inst, op=g['op'], workgroups=len(g['slices']),
                         arrival_us=(g['arrive'] - cutoff) / 100,
                         last_ready_us=(g['ready'] - cutoff) / 100,
                         last_end_us=(g['end'] - cutoff) / 100,
                         ready_envelope_us=(g['ready'] - g['arrive']) / 100,
                         completion_tail_us=(g['end'] - g['ready']) / 100,
                         mean_workgroup_body_us=g['body'] / len(g['slices']) / 100))
    by_op = {}
    for row in rows:
        g = by_op.setdefault(row['op'], dict(instructions=0, workgroups=0, sum_ready_envelope_us=0, sum_completion_tail_us=0))
        g['instructions'] += 1
        g['workgroups'] += row['workgroups']
        g['sum_ready_envelope_us'] += row['ready_envelope_us']
        g['sum_completion_tail_us'] += row['completion_tail_us']
    return dict(cutoff_latest_embed_end=cutoff, stale_records=stale, empty_records=empty,
                wall_after_embed_us=max(r['last_end_us'] for r in rows),
                instructions=rows, by_op=by_op)


def main():
    root = Path(__file__).parent
    text = Path('/tmp/tp-glm53-moe-resident/packet-on.json').read_text()
    packet = json.loads(text[text.index('{'):])
    program = next(p for p in packet['programs'] if p['t'] == 20)
    native = {'GemmLtPf', 'MoeAiterFp8Pf'}
    expected = {i['idx']: i for i in program['insts'] if i['idx'] != 0 and i['op_name'] not in native}
    ranks = {}
    sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    for rank in range(8):
        path = root / 'trace' / f'trace.bin.rk{rank}'
        ranks[str(rank)] = parse(path.read_bytes(), expected)
        ranks[str(rank)]['trace_sha256'] = sha(path)
    arm_results = {}
    for arm in ('control', 'trace'):
        log = (root / arm / 'run.log').read_text()
        match = re.search(r'5 timed batched steps .*?: ([0-9.]+) ms/step', log)
        assert match, arm
        chains = re.findall(r'^  (\[[0-9, ]+\])$', log, re.M)
        assert len(chains) == 20 and all(len(json.loads(c)) == 6 for c in chains)
        assert 'all 8 ranks token-identical' in log
        arm_results[arm] = dict(mean_step_ms=float(match[1]), chains=[json.loads(c) for c in chains],
                                source=json.loads((root / arm / 'source.json').read_text()))
    record = dict(schema='plow.glm.resident-interpreter-trace.v1', date='2026-09-10',
                  artifact_root=str(root), ranks=ranks, arms=arm_results,
                  native_instructions_without_trace=dict(collections.Counter(i['op_name'] for i in program['insts'] if i['op_name'] in native)),
                  exact_control_trace_chains=arm_results['control']['chains'] == arm_results['trace']['chains'],
                  parser_source=Path(__file__).read_text(), parser_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),
                  limitations=[
                      'Repeated-token diagnostic with all 20 KV slots populated; not random serving performance.',
                      'Native GEMM and MoE launches do not write interpreter trace records.',
                      'Latest Embed completion excludes stale prefill/earlier-step records. Embed itself is omitted from attribution.',
                      'Per-instruction envelopes overlap; their sums are not GPU wall-time fractions. Completion tail excludes work before the last workgroup becomes ready.',
                      'All timestamps are compared within one rank only. Trace overhead is assessed with the control, not assumed absent.',
                  ])
    (root / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(arms={k: v['mean_step_ms'] for k, v in arm_results.items()},
                          rank0=ranks['0']['by_op']), indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
